items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had met Dick during the time I was getting my card, when I came back to town he and Woody Woodward grabbed me to do a lot of work.

ctx.x: Now, how did you meet Chet in the first place?

I think Dick Bock set that up. I had met Dick during the time I was getting my card, when I came back to town he and Woody Woodward grabbed me to do a lot of work. Those guys sort of, you know, getting started in California, especially in those days was very tough. I came in with sort of a New York reputation but no work and no connections at all and I'm not very good at that sort of thing.
What was your plan, did you consciously want to get into film writing or was that an afterthought?
